verdict.rationale: Gram offers a few data-portability pieces. Tool-call audit logs are described as "one exportable record." Telemetry delivery can be configured to send data out. Tool sources are open, user-owned formats (OpenAPI documents, TypeScript Functions), and skills are plain SKILL.md manifests. The platform MCP server and CLI also let you read observability data and manage resources programmatically. However, nothing documents a complete account or data export, and the export formats are never specified. Missing for 10: documented full-account export covering all resources, configs, policies and logs; stated open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV); offboarding or data-deletion guidance; independent corroboration that a clean exit is possible.
